question: A student holds a single narrow slit vertically and looks at a distant light source through it. What is the orientation of the diffraction pattern observed on the retina?

options.A: A vertical series of bright and dark spots.
options.B: A horizontal series of bright and dark spots.
options.C: A circular pattern of concentric rings.
options.D: A single bright spot with no fringes.
